anchor.description: Position on the screen where notifications appear.

app_overrides.description: List of per-application notification settings to override global defaults.

icon.description: Custom icon name or path (e.g., 'dialog-warning' or '/usr/share/icons/my-icon.png'); leave empty for default.

name.description: Name of the application (as it appears in the notification sender).

timeout.description: Custom timeout (ms) for this app's notifications.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog (for troubleshooting only).

default_timeout.description: Default time (in milliseconds) before a notification automatically disappears.

font.description: Pango font description (e.g., "Ubuntu 11" or "DejaVu Sans Bold 12") for notification text.

icon_size.description: Size (in pixels) of the notification icons.

margin.description: Distance (in pixels) between the notification and the screen edge.

max_visible.description: Maximum number of notifications shown simultaneously (older ones will be queued).

queue_notifications.description: If true, queue new notifications instead of replacing visible ones.

text_color.description: Hex color (RRGGBB) for notification message text.
